summary: The source creates exactly floor(dim²/sparsity) nonzeros and writes the terminal CSR offset. Width is selected from the average row count (2/4/8/16/32); blocks=ceil(dim*width/256) provide one subgroup per row, with each lane processing all CSR entries in its width-stride and lane 0 storing the reduced row. Main performs one warmup when iterations and blocks are nonzero, then the timed loop launches exactly iterations times and synchronizes before reading output. Compiled main preserves the loop and calls the width-specialized CUDA launch stubs; all five native sm86 variants were inspected through their work loops and stores.
